assessment_labels: Only authorized development source for included inner blocks after every family candidate is sealed or has a sealed solver failure. No outer score accessor.
evidence: Baseline outer outcomes already inspected. S4 output is chronological development evidence, not a new blind test.
excluded_blocks: Feature-only common support fixed before labels; excluded candidates have a sealed block-level exclusion, no fit, no assessment loss.
owner_execution: Implementation and bounded rehearsals first; full historical run owner-launched.
resume: Atomic directory publication; immutable run binding; verify committed file hashes; ignore uncommitted scratch; no overwrite of completed units.
reuse: Identical inner TRAIN and ASSESS date populations are checked for every consuming outer vintage. Canonical outer ID is the earliest containing vintage. Forecasts are stored once; selections explicitly reference shared block score hashes.
selection: S3 registered loss, day weighting, minimum two blocks, score tolerance and descending tie policy unchanged. Diagnostics tuned separately.
solver_failure: All S3 starts fail: invalidate entire candidate across all included inner blocks for that outer vintage. Never shrink common support. Unexpected errors stop resumably.
unsupported_outer: No selectable model, insufficient support, or selected refit failure yields one explicit abstention per expected issue; release marked FROZEN_WITH_UNSUPPORTED_MODELS. No fallback or retuning.
